Definition: from G4862 and the base of G2201; to yoke together, i.e. (figuratively) conjoin (in marriage):--join together.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus says of marriage, what God has joined together, let no man put asunder. The word is a yoke-word: two oxen yoked to pull as one. Marriage, in His picture, is not a contract men can dissolve at will; it is a joining God Himself has done.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that marriage is God's joining before it is ours, and that is why Jesus speaks of it with such finality.
